'''Beauchen''' was the site of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] penal colony.

{{Planet-stub}}

==History==
In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was warned by the control of a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] base that they knew he had been sniffing out evidence for imprisoning them for twenty years in [[Fodurant]] or Beauchen.
